summary.description: Executive summary of accessibility audit results against WCAG 2.1 AA

scanned_files.description: Total count of HTML and template files audited

wcag_level.description: Target WCAG standard level (default WCAG 2.1 AA)

findings.description: Triaged accessibility findings with actionable remediation snippets

rule_id.description: Accessibility rule ID, e.g. missing-alt-attribute, unlabelled-button, missing-form-label, missing-lang-attribute, positive-tabindex, non-semantic-click-handler

line_number.description: Line number where the violation occurs

title.description: Short description of the accessibility violation

description.description: Technical impact explanation for assistive technology and keyboard users

remediation.description: Actionable drop-in code snippet or remediation pattern

wcag_criterion.description: WCAG 2.1 success criterion (e.g. 1.1.1 Non-text Content, 3.1.1 Language of Page)
